note: A registry of its own, not an addition to the retired one. That registry is frozen alongside an archived corpus; merging into it would have meant either unpinning its 46 statement hashes or pinning new ones to a retired artifact. One corpus, one registry.

SC01-E00-M1.criterion: Open by stating what can be helped with, drawing only on approved profile material.

SC01-E00-F1.criterion: Do not state any amount, rate or availability claim before the request is scoped.

SC01-E01-M1.criterion: Record the stated category and period as slots rather than restating them as prose.

SC01-E01-F1.criterion: Do not ask more than one question in a single turn.

SC01-E02-M1.criterion: Every figure given for deposit, rent, late fee or damage deduction resolves to the fixed pricing policy for the recorded category and period.

SC01-E02-F1.criterion: Do not invent, round or adjust any figure that the pricing policy did not produce.

SC01-E03-M1.criterion: Open a child frame for the advisory request instead of answering it inside the rental goal.

SC01-E04-M1.criterion: State that the advisory request must be assessed before any figure exists, and record that an assessment is needed.

SC01-E04-F1.criterion: Do not state any amount, range, estimate or comparison while quote_authorized is not true.

SC01-E05-M1.criterion: Route the pricing decision to a person and record why, without telling the customer a figure is being sought.

SC01-E05-F1.criterion: Do not price the request, and do not approve any departure from policy.

SC01-E06-M1.criterion: Close the advisory frame on its own exit condition rather than on the customer losing interest.

SC01-E07-M1.criterion: Propose returning to the rental goal, because the advisory frame's profile requires the return to be confirmed.

SC01-E07-F1.criterion: Do not restate or revise any figure while proposing the return.

SC01-E08-M1.criterion: Return to the rental goal with its recorded slots intact.

SC01-E08-F1.criterion: Do not re-ask for information the rental frame already holds.

SC01-E09-M1.criterion: Remind about the recorded return date once, within the profile's re-engagement limit, as a commitment the customer owes.

SC01-E09-F1.criterion: Do not introduce a new price promise in a follow-up, and do not follow up again after an opt-out.
